preconditions.description: The length of the permutations must be between 1 and 2000.
Both permutations p and s must have exactly n elements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in p) and all(1 <= x <= n for x in s)
preconditions.description: All elements in permutations p and s must be within the range from 1 to n.
Both permutations p and s must contain unique elements.

postconditions.description: The first line of output must be the minimum number of coins required.
The second line of output must be the number of operations k.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n and i != j for i, j in operations)
postconditions.description: Each operation must consist of valid indices i and j within the range from 1 to n, and i must not equal j.
The number of operations printed must match the number k specified in the output.
